_approach: True 8ths-to-16ths-to-32nds acceleration on a 32nd grid: bar 1 keeps the halfstep skeleton (kick on 1, snare on 3, syncopated kicks creeping toward the end of the bar) under a breathing shaker; bar 2 drops the kick and doubles the snare from 8ths to 16ths to 32nds while hats double alongside, ending on two silent 32nds as the gap before the drop. Ref: MusicRadar 'How to create the ultimate snare roll build-up'; Attack Magazine '10 Snare Rolls For The Drop'. (re-voiced for the Vermona DRM1 MKIII's 8 channels)
